title: Feed source access
description: How the deployment reaches each feed source. Sources and their endpoints are traust-core's shipped feeds registry; this document only overrides a source's access, and a source it does not name keeps its shipped access. api: fetched over the network; air-gapped: no network reads, the adopter supplies the data (osv: an offline osv-scanner database); disabled: never fetched. A Tier 2 setting: a scope-ref document imported whole with no assessment and versioned by traust-core's settings service (`traust settings`), so a change is a successor version with its `revision`, never an edit; readers take the latest.

revision.description: Who set this version and why. Written by traust-core's settings service from the verified caller (or the recording run) and its clock; a caller never supplies it.

set_by.description: The principal (<kind>:<identity>) or run that set this version.

reason.description: Why it changed, in the setter's words.
